items: Full Cabinet Protection – Jin&Bao under sink mat reinforced with a thicker, tougher silicone structure for enhanced durability and support. The 1.6 cm raised edge securely holds spills and leaks, shielding your cabinets, shelves, and floors from water damage, stains, and scratches.
One-Piece Technology – Crafted from silicone using advanced one-piece molding technology, this kitchen sink protector combines durability, flexibility, and a seamless design.

Smart Storage Solution – More than just a drip tray, the mat doubles as an organizer. Its textured, anti-slip surface keeps cleaning supplies, bathroom essentials, or kitchen items neatly in place. Also perfect as a pet mat, drying mat, shelf liner, or waterproof mat anywhere at home.

How to Choose – Available in multiple sizes to fit most kitchen and bathroom cabinets. Simply measure your cabinet’s depth and width before ordering; if in doubt, select a slightly smaller size silicone tray for the best fit.

Easy to Clean & Maintain – The waterproof, oil-resistant surface wipes clean in seconds. Jin&Bao undersink mat is dishwasher safe, easy to remove, and simple to install. It keeps your furniture looking like new, and keeps your kitchen and bathroom dry and tidy.
